Travel claims procedure
Artificial M7c corpus. No rule in this document describes a real
business.
File travel claims within 10 business days.
The coordinator records the applicable procedure in the local
handbook. Staff check the scope of this edition before opening a
case and keep the administrative record with the relevant team.
This fictional procedure explains a limited operational task.
The desk reviews supporting material, records the request and
forwards any unresolved question through its normal internal
workflow.
Employees identify the appropriate category and retain the case
reference. A supervisor checks that the team has selected the
correct edition and that the information remains consistent.
